convention.algebra: sedenions, D = 16, cd_core.cd_sign, doubling (a,b)(c,d) = (ac - conj(d) b, da + b conj(c))
convention.basis: e_k is basis state |k>, index bit b on register qubit b
convention.design_b: P(selector=0) = N(x y)/8 = ||x y||^2 / 2 for x = (e_L + x_sign e_U)/sqrt2, y = (e_L' + y_sign e_U')/sqrt2
convention.diagonal: (L, U, s) is e_L + s e_U with L in 1..7 and U in 9..15

open_gororoba_comparison.map: identity on (low, high) and on signs; box_kite id -> strut_signature (the census strut constant)

strut_table_columns_read_as_struts.reading: (A,F), (B,E), (C,D) as strut pairs; the CSV writer sorts assessors by (low, high) before filling A..F

twist.claim: (sB e_B + sb e_b)(sD e_D + sd e_d) = 0 iff (sB e_B + sd e_d)(sD e_D - sb e_b) = 0, b, d in 1..7, B, D in 9..15, b != d, B != D
